findings.original_text: Archived records show that eight browser end-to-end scenarios and eight high-risk confirmation and idempotency tests passed. Extraction from four synthetic seed notes achieved 100.00% precision, recall, and F1 against 52 internally compiled reference relations; these scores describe agreement with that checklist. In 20 archived questions from the Python prototype before its migration to Rust, ordinary retrieval and graph-enhanced retrieval completed 4/20 and 14/20 questions under the rule-based measure, while citation syntax and range checks passed 17/20 and 15/20 answers. Four configurations using current Rust retrieval evidence produced 144 answers. One-hop relations achieved 74.44% fact coverage versus 46.67% for document retrieval (question-level p=0.0938, above the 0.05 threshold). Semantic evaluation and role-based API checks involved no human participants.
